title: Waseela English Medium School
cardDescription: School website showcasing academics, facilities and admissions — plus a branded Android app.
overview: A professional website for Waseela English Medium School presenting its academics, facilities and admissions. The school also has its own branded Android app built from the Education ERP.
problem: The school needed a clear online presence for parents and visitors.
solution: A structured, responsive website with academics, facilities, gallery, admissions and contact pages.
result: School information is accessible to parents and students from any device.
